name: orderbhojan

scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting:orderbhojan --project orderbhojan
scripts.icons:generate: node scripts/generate-app-icons.mjs && npx capacitor-assets generate --iconBackgroundColor "#070504" --splashBackgroundColor "#070504" --assetPath resources --ios --android && node scripts/generate-app-icons.mjs --fix-android-adaptive
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && node scripts/android-gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node scripts/android-gradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.android:apk:debug: npm run android:sync && node scripts/android-gradle.mjs assembleDebug
